Celeriac can be consumed either raw
or cooked. Regardless of how it is to be
used, the root must be rinsed well and
peeled.  After it is peeled, the pieces
should be dropped into a bowl of acidu-
lated water (water to which a few drops of
lemon juice or vinegar have been added)
to prevent the discoloration that occurs
from exposure to the air.  The raw root
can be cut into sticks for dipping, or it
can be grated or julienned for salads.
